coding: 1 visible presence; 0 visible absence with the relevant part sufficiently visible; null if cropped, obscured or ambiguous. These are graphical descriptions, not biological diagnoses or object identities.
PLANT12: green_blade
A bounded leaf-like blade visibly filled green.
blue_fill
Any visibly blue filled region within the selected motif.
red_brown_fill
A red/ochre/brown filled region, beyond thin ink outlines.
root_fan
At least three narrow basal strands spreading from a common base.
thick_root
A basal root-like axis with two visible contours and width greater than a thin filament.
root_branching
Basal root-like structure has at least one split into three or more terminal branches.
rounded_bulb
A conspicuous rounded or oval basal swelling with width greater than its connecting stem.
toothed_blade
At least one leaf-like blade has three or more visible edge teeth or lobes.
broad_blade
At least one leaf-like blade has length no more than three times its maximum width.
narrow_blade
At least one leaf-like blade has length more than three times its maximum width.
terminal_head
An upper rounded, cup-like or clustered terminal form distinct from ordinary blades.
branched_stem
The above-base stem visibly divides into at least two branches.
FIGURE12: head_cover
A separate outlined cap, hat or crown-like contour above the head; hair alone excluded.
long_hair
Drawn hair strands extend below the neck/shoulder line.
face_left
The visible nose/profile points to the left in the delivered unrotated image.
face_right
The visible nose/profile points to the right in the delivered unrotated image.
raised_arm
At least one arm or hand extends above its shoulder level.
bent_arm
At least one visible arm has an elbow angle discernibly less than a straight extension.
star_connection
A star-like radial form is visibly joined to a hand by a stalk/line, or directly held.
lower_enclosure
The lower body is inside an outlined vessel/tub-like enclosure.
long_garment
A continuous outlined garment covers the torso and extends below the hips.
two_legs
Two separate legs are visibly drawn outside any enclosure.
hatched_enclosure
The associated body enclosure contains parallel hatching or repetitive patterned fill.
lateral_connector
A line/tube visibly links the selected figure or its enclosure laterally to another motif, excluding its own star stalk.
VESSEL12: Main bounded body is taller than wide.
Main bounded body is wider than tall.
Three or more parallel internal hatch marks.
A drawn human-like figure visibly contacts the structure.
Two or more bounded connected compartments.
layout_band: P: discrete horizontal specimen row, numbered top to bottom within page. Z: inner/middle/outer figure ring, based on drawn circles rather than labels. B: upper/middle/lower third of source page by motif centre. Unknown band remains unknown and is excluded from the layout sensitivity.
human_review: Read each card without its EVA label or expected match. Record uncertainty rather than guessing. A broad belly or rounded contour has no pregnancy interpretation. Do not infer the meaning of a word. All original pages have previously been exposed to the assistant.
